feedback:
This candidate is valid and tests one variable against the best raced design. Sensor y moves from 0.05 to 0.07 m, with x spacing (-0.04 to 0.04 m), 16 mm footprints, kp 3.0, kd 0.8, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.3, mass 0.6 kg and last_direction line loss unchanged. The evidence is iteration 6 (score 570.4). Moving y from 0.03 to 0.05 raised oval finishes from 10/20 to 20/20, s-bend finishes from 0/20 to 9/20, and slalom progress from 0.28 to 0.41. Slalom still finished 0/20 with max_error near 0.06 m and steering_oscillation about 0.30. Iteration 7 is the same plan and has not raced, so this is the first real test of the 0.07 m look-ahead. Nothing here predicts how it will perform.

After the race, read the results in this order. (a) If oval completion falls below 20/20, or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, the far-forward lead is overshooting on straights or amplifying jitter. Return y to 0.06 m, and if jitter is the problem, lower kd toward 0.6. (b) If the slalom still exits off track at max_error near 0.06 m with no progress gain over iteration 6, the look-ahead is no longer the limit, so steering authority is. Raise kp toward 3.3 with kd held. Iteration 4 showed kp 3.7 hurt the harder tracks at y 0.03, so keep the step small. (c) If the robot stays on the line but s-bend or slalom progress stalls below 0.3 with no off-track exit, base_speed is too low for the 3 s limit. Raise it in 0.1 steps toward 1.4 or 1.5, since iteration 1 finished the oval at 1.65 s at base 1.4.

Because this is a clean single-variable test of the best lever found so far, approve it so the race returns per-track telemetry for the look-ahead effect.
requested_changes: If oval completion drops below 20/20 or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, return sensor y to 0.06 m, since iteration 6 showed y 0.05 was the best oval result, and lower kd from 0.8 toward 0.6 if the jitter persists.

If slalom still exits off track at max_error near 0.06 m with no progress gain over iteration 6's 0.41, raise kp from 3.0 toward 3.3 with kd held at 0.8, because iteration 4 showed kp 3.7 hurt harder tracks and a small step is safer.
If s-bend or slalom progress stays below 0.3 with no off-track exit, raise base_speed from 1.3 toward 1.4 in 0.1 steps with the same gains, since the 3 s limit needs about 1.5 m/s average.
